section FROM applications a JOIN campuses c ON c.id=a.campus_id JOIN programs p ON p.id=a.program_id JOIN academic_terms t ON t.id=a.term_id JOIN academic_years y ON y.id=t.academic_year_id LEFT JOIN queuePlans.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM applications a JOIN campuses c ON c.id=a.campus_id JOIN programs p ON p.id=a.program_id JOIN academic_terms t ON t.id=a.term_id JOIN academic_years y ON y.id=t.academic_year_id LEFT JOIN students st ON st.id=a.student_id LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON e.application_id=a.id LEFT JOIN sections s ON s.id=e.section_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE rt.mandatory)=0 THEN 'Pending' WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE rt.mandatory AND coalesce(ar.status,'pending')<>'submitted')=0 THEN 'Complete' WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE rt.mandatory AND ar.status IN ('missing','invalid'))>0 THEN 'Incomplete' ELSE 'Pending' END AS status,max(ar.updated_at) AS updated_at FROM requirement_types rt LEFT JOIN application_requirements ar ON ar.requirement_code=rt.code AND ar.application_id=a.id ) creds WHERE a.campus_id IN (?) AND a.campus_id=? AND a.term_id=?

SELECT a.id,a.application_number AS "applicationNumber",concat_ws(' ',a.first_name,a.last_name) AS name, a.campus_id AS "campusId",c.name AS campus,a.term_id AS "termId",concat(y.label,' / ',t.name) AS term, a.program_id AS "programId",p.code AS program,a.status,a.version, a.first_name AS "firstName",a.middle_name AS "middleName",a.last_name AS "lastName",a.lrn,a.category, a.submitted_at::date AS "submittedAt",a.updated_at AS "updatedAt",p.category AS "programCategory", CASE WHEN p.category='TVET' THEN 'TVET' WHEN p.code LIKE 'TVL_%' THEN 'TVL' ELSE 'ACADEMIC' END AS track, a.student_id AS "studentId",st.student_number AS "studentNumber",a.contact_phone AS phone,a.email, coalesce(a.profile->>'gradeLevel','') AS "gradeLevel",coalesce(a.profile->>'district','') AS district, coalesce(a.profile->>'transportRoute','') AS "transportRoute",creds.status AS "requirementsStatus",creds.updated_at AS "requirementsUpdatedAt", EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM orientation_attendance o WHERE o.application_id=a.id AND o.status='present') AS "attendancePresent", e.id AS "enrollmentId",e.version AS "enrollmentVersion",e.status AS "enrollmentStatus", e.section_id AS "sectionId",s.name AS section FROM applications a JOIN campuses c ON c.id=a.campus_id JOIN programs p ON p.id=a.program_id JOIN academic_terms t ON t.id=a.term_id JOIN academic_years y ON y.id=t.academic_year_id LEFT JOIN students st ON st.id=a.student_id LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON e.application_id=a.id LEFT JOIN sections s ON s.id=e.section_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE rt.mandatory)=0 THEN 'Pending' WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE rt.mandatory AND coalesce(ar.status,'pending')<>'submitted')=0 THEN 'Complete' WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE rt.mandatory AND ar.status IN ('missing','invalid'))>0 THEN 'Incomplete' ELSE 'Pending' END AS status,max(ar.updated_at) AS updated_at FROM requirement_types rt LEFT JOIN application_requirements ar ON ar.requirement_code=rt.code AND ar.application_id=a.id ) creds WHERE a.campus_id IN (?) AND a.campus_id=? AND a.term_id=? ORDER BY a.submitted_at DESC,a.id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

methodology: Read-only connection; direct service calls with current DB actor grants and explicit permission check. Request attributes reproduce per-request permission reuse. Includes JDBC wire time, excludes HTTP transport, Spring transaction/pool management, JWT crypto and rendering. Direct-service phase issues no tokens or writes; see liveApiMethod for optional HTTP sampling.
liveApiMethod: Five sequential GETs per endpoint against running backend; existing registrar/admin identities, current grants/version and private local signing key; three-minute audit JWTs never printed/saved. Normal authentication/policy filters remain enabled. No logout/revocation write was performed; tokens expire naturally.
